Hi! Re SLOTPLAN-123 (format_agenda): from the design review notes I have — a meeting that ends after midnight (end > 1440) gets a "+1" suffix on its end time, e.g. "23:00-01:00+1  Release (2h)". A meeting ending exactly at 1440 has no suffix. Hope that helps!

Hi! Re: SLOTPLAN-118 (expand_weekly), the design review decision was: a dropped occurrence still uses up one of the `count` occurrences (like an excluded date in a fixed-length calendar series), so the result can be shorter than `count`; the series is not extended to make up for it. Hope that helps!
